about: Milestone-1 task 131: the Moonlit Shrine's nobori banners and grass, built by scripts/blender/build_banners_grass.py into blender/shrine/nobori.blend and grass.blend in the asset repository (the owner's answers, Oct 7: twelve banners round the ledge, dark weathered cloth in black, deep purple and faded ivory, each with a brushed kanji column and the gold sagari-fuji mon at its head, no side colours; short grass in the paving's breaks, the project's own blade cards). The kanji are the game's own (its cut Yuji Boku): 一騎討 (single combat), 決戦 (the deciding battle), 勝利 (victory) and 義戦 (a righteous war).
